Self.Wiki: Invisible physical geometry. Besides blocking movement, a collision tells the game about the floor a character stands on: its reverb, indoor or outdoor sound, water surface height, lighting and the display groups to show. Depending on its Hit Filter ID it can instead be an invisible wall for some characters only, a water surface, a detection area or a trigger (instant death, warp and so on). Assets that use a collision copy several of these values unless they override them.

HitFilterID.Wiki: What the collision collides with, and whether it is a trigger. 8 (and any value not listed) is normal solid map collision. Trigger IDs collide with nothing and run an action on the character that touches them; 15 and 21 are confirmed in AC6, the other trigger names follow Elden Ring, whose trigger handler AC6 shares. 24 always starts disabled. Retail: 8 ×419, 29 ×159, 17 ×33, 11 ×26, 22 ×24, 15 ×14, 9 ×12, 16 and 28 ×9, 13, 24, 30 and 31 once each.

SoundSpaceType.Wiki: The reverb used while a character stands on this collision. -1 keeps the default. The values match the rows of WwiseValueToStrParam_ReverbAuxBusType. Set on 17 retail collisions (1-7).

OutdoorIndoorType.Wiki: The Wwise outdoor/indoor sound state while a character stands on this collision. -1 keeps the default. Half and fully indoor also count as indoor for other systems that check whether the character is under cover. Set on 77 retail collisions.

ReflectPlaneHeight.Wiki: Height of the reflective (water) surface above the collision's position. Foot effects of floor materials set to Force to Reflective Surface Height (HitMtrlParam) spawn at this height instead of at the feet. 0 on most collisions; 3000 on 72 collisions in m10_10_00_00.

StartDisabled.Wiki: If ON, the collision starts switched off (for example until an event enables it), and so do the assets that use it as their collision unless they override this. On for 178 retail collisions, mostly Hit Filter ID 29 areas.

Collision_Unk27.Wiki: An unknown flag read by the game. Off on every retail collision.

Collision_Unk36.Wiki: If ON, the collision is switched off by a map-wide pass that also handles Hit Filter ID 29 areas; when that pass runs is not known. On for 10 Hit Filter ID 29 areas in m20_30_00_00 and one solid collision in m41_00_00_00.

Collision_Unk37.Wiki: Passed to the character standing on this collision; 1 and 2 change a value there. 0 on every retail collision.

LayoutPath.Wiki: Not used by the game. Empty on every retail collision.
